Name: SNES Toast of the Town starring Evermore Toaster Dogs
Author: cryomancer199x
Description:
So this mod got a little out of control with feature creep. I've got a bunch more I'd like to do with it yet but I figured I should get a release out already.

[b]What even is this??

[/b]This mod adds two new big craftable machines. They are both Toaster Dogs, as seen in Secret of Evermore. If you've seen my Evermore dogs mod, this is why Toasters were not in that one. So what do they do? They turn bread into toast, mostly. Toast can then be turned into new cooking items the townsfolk will teach you via letters in the mail as you befriend them. This mod should be fairly early/mid-game, I think. Nothing too crazy required. There are also a few items added to the stores to help you make more toasts.

[b]What kind of toast are we talkin' about?

[/b]A whole bunch. There's light and dark toast made by each dog. Those can be cooked into recipes for light and dark variants of the food. Some foods only have one version, that may change in the future if there's demand for it. Usually you'll just want the light toast. Most of the new items this adds also come with a semi-relevant food buff, try em out and see what you get. Most of them are positive.

[b]Can this do anything else?

[/b]There are a few other things that can be put into a toaster. Some of the letters should give you ideas. [b]If you use Automate,[/b] be careful with these, they may give you results you do not expect / want. They will however work fine with it. I believe Chests Anywhere has a feature for filtering chests a bit, that might be useful there.

[b]Future plans?

[/b]I've got way too many toast ideas. I'd like to make a hat/accessory with a buff, a trinket, add gift tastes, some config options, and have toast inherit colors from jelly and roe. But i am not there yet skill wise and really had to cut myself off and get this out already, so it's just food and mail for now.

The assets for this mod include an alternate set of more orange sprites for the light toast, that may eventually become a config option, but for now if you want that just swap the graphics around or change the sprite indexes in the json. Maybe I'll make an alternate download for it later.

[b]Issues?[/b]

Hopefully none now, but please tell me if something is broken, or makes no sense, breaks lore hard, whatever. I made an attempt to balance these a bit and write the mail similarly to vanilla, feedback is welcome though. All screenshots were taken during development, with other mods enabled, and minor things may be different.
